features: Automatically roll for nicknames that match your preferred name, rank or skin.
Get alerts when a player may be using Scaffold, with settings to control alerts.
Choose whether Fury answers Quick Maths for you.
Get reminders when your Hypixel API key is getting old, with an option to remind you later.
See a summary of your results after each game.
improvements: Easier-to-use launcher menus, settings and game summary previews.
More reliable saved nicknames and real player names.
More accurate tracking of broken beds and game results in Bed Wars.
Removed Seraph support and the Slumber daily-rewards reminder.
fixes: Private Bed Wars games no longer count toward your public stats.
Missing stats no longer appear as zero.
Stats from several games are no longer counted as one game's results.
Fixed issues with session results, stats appearing under the wrong account and games being checked twice.

features: See your average game length in the summary after a game.
improvements: Hear a sound when Fury asks you to match nicknames to your party members.
fixes: Your session totals stay visible even when some game stats are missing.
Your session FKDR can still be shown when Fury has enough game stats.
Auto Dodge waits until Fury knows who is in your party, helping avoid leaving because of a teammate.

features: Share Scaffold alerts in party chat without reporting teammates.
Turn party cheat alerts on or off in AntiCheat settings.
See spawned diamond and emerald totals, next-spawn timers and upcoming Bed Wars events in Tab.
See session totals and per-game averages for final kills and broken beds in game summaries.
Browse your recorded games with /session games.
See what's new when an update is available or you launch a new version.
improvements: Clearer session stats and replay details.
Choose whether game summaries show your average game length.
Legacy nick matching now looks for names with up to eight characters.
Simpler AntiCheat settings, with AutoBlock and Stasis turned off.
Removed automatic quest acceptance from Gambler George.
Choose Don't show again to hide a release's notification, even after restarting Fury.
fixes: Auto Dodge checks again before leaving so newly identified teammates won't trigger it.
Bed Wars Duels no longer count as regular Bed Wars games.
Game stats stay attached to the right match when Hypixel updates them late.
Session final kills and broken beds remain counted when older game details are removed.
Replay stats can still appear when the game's win or loss is unknown.
Players whose stats couldn't be loaded are no longer shared as confirmed threats.
Nametags no longer disappear for an entire team when one player drinks an invisibility potion.

features: Windows installer users can download updates in Fury and choose when to restart.
AutoDenick can suggest possible real names from final kills or broken beds before checking both to confirm a match.
Automatically save a teammate's nickname when only one party member can match, with Undo.
See your current and previously saved nicknames with /denick self.
improvements: Urchin checks tags in small groups while available player stats keep loading.
Tab Stats shows available stats early, and Scan shows everyone together once checks finish.
Denick searches check more players and compare final kills and broken beds more carefully before confirming a match.
Denick messages show stats and tags together in chat, with fewer repeated notices.
AutoDenick announces when it starts checking finals, beds, or both, once per player for each check.
Auto Dodge ignores Replays, Account and Blacklisted tags, and only dodges Caution when cheats are listed.
Choose whether Auto Dodge leaves instantly or just before the game starts.
Copy your API keys and Minecraft addresses with a Copy button.
Reset to defaults now restores all three preset Minecraft connections.
Player stats recover from more temporary loading problems and keep already loaded stats visible.
fixes: Tab Stats no longer gets stuck or loses loaded stats when Hypixel refreshes the player list.
Quick Duels and rematches now count toward your session.
Finished games, kills and broken beds stay saved when stats arrive late or you disconnect, end or reset a session.
Refreshing stats no longer starts a new session during a game.
Session stats no longer use another account's results.
Player names above heads in Duels no longer turn white during a game.
Auto Dodge no longer cancels a planned leave during the final Bed Wars countdown warning.
Automatic skin and stats denicks no longer reveal party members in party chat.

features: Mute repeated lobby messages until you disconnect, with Undo and a muted-player list.
Pick and claim Daily Reward cards in chat, with an optional auto-pick mode.
Report one player with /wdr without opening the confirmation menu, then see whether it succeeded.
Customize the BedWars scoreboard with six color styles, FKDR decimal digits and extra spacing.
Choose whether individual Share messages include monthly FKDR.
Share uses team summaries by default to keep party chat shorter, with individual messages also available.
improvements: Fury keeps track of your party without filling chat with party lists, helping keep nicked teammates private.
Individual Share messages arrive as players finish scanning, without waiting for their teammates.
Party announcements for newly denicked players now include their tags and listed cheats.
fixes: Nicked teammates who use an existing Minecraft name can now be saved automatically from your party.
Reconnecting quickly no longer crashes Fury while restoring your party.
Players removed from your party after disconnecting no longer stay on Fury's party list.

features: Choose a Christmas look in Appearance with snowfall, snowy edges, warm lights and a snowflake mouse trail.
Find changed settings with New and Updated tags that clear after you’ve seen them.
Add Fury servers to Minecraft with automatic client detection on Windows, clear status, the main connection first and existing connections reused.
Report a Bed Wars team with `/wdr <team>`, with automatic pauses while you move or use inventory.
On the Sessions page, use the arrow keys to move between sessions, click a card or press Space to see it full size, or hide the list for a bigger card.
improvements: New installs start with party denick announcements, automatic scan sharing and Ender Dust reminders turned off.
Windows updates install faster, can use smaller downloads and show a retry message if installation did not finish.
Browse updates by version in a clearer What’s new window, with larger text, Dashboard highlights and links to settings.
Nicks shows saved matches in a compact, sortable table, with details available when you open a match.
The redesigned launcher has clearer navigation, reorganized settings and Start/Stop controls on the Dashboard.
Session and mode stats keep your recorded kills, finals and beds visible and catch up when Hypixel updates late.
Bed Wars recaps are easier to read with gold labels and different greens for stats and averages.
Session cards are easier to read, with your main stats in large numbers and a clearer games-by-mode bar; copied and saved images use the new look.
The session list shows a Minecraft item for each game, so it's easier to find a session at a glance.
Connection settings are simpler, with one row per connection and any problem shown on that row; copy your Minecraft address from the Dashboard.
Scanning and Auto Dodge sliders feel smoother, give common values more room and let you hold Shift while dragging for finer control.
fixes: The Players preview now matches shared party messages and follows your chosen settings.
Shared stat threats show the stat that triggered them, using FKDR when both FKDR and stars qualify.
Scaffold alerts show the real IGN for players with a known denick.
Saved denicks keep the right player's stats after name changes.
Party Broadcast now shares saved opponent nicknames at game start and includes their stats when available.
Games in session history keep their detected mode instead of appearing as Unspecified.
Fixed missed stats in sessions and saved games after reconnects, quick requeues, slow starts and late nickname, team or kill messages.
Fixed missing or incorrect wins in session history, including when you confirm a BedWars result yourself.
Session history keeps the correct game total and win rate when older game details are cleared.
Daily stats keep recorded kills, finals and wins when a session crosses midnight.
Session stats keep counting when you turn API requests on or off.
Draws count as games without adding a win or loss.
